title: RAW UNREVIEWED: exact word doubling predicts an external right-context change beyond the left context
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_TESTED. Compare maximal exact XX runs with single X within the same physical leaf and word, measuring external right-versus-left context association after fixed position conditioning. This distinguishes a narrow context-neutral duplication model from a directionally conditioned repetition construction, without translating either.

design.mechanism_contrast: A context-neutral local copy duplicates X without changing the external lexical environment. A boundary/reprise or discourse-reset construction can instead select the following context differently. Both are hypotheses; real copying errors can depend on context, and intentional repetition need not reset it.
design.unit: A maximal exact raw run of length1 or2 within an admitted physical P line, with a definite seam and one observed external whole group on each side. XXX and longer runs are not decomposed into overlapping XX pairs; retain their excluded counts. Do not fuse entities, pool readers, or cross physical-line boundaries.
design.comparison: Within exact whole form X × physical leaf × predeclared physical-position strata, compare the run-length association with external right-neighbour identity to its association with external left-neighbour identity. Keep only strata with both singleton and double runs. Strata/position bins, uncertain-seam exclusions and all eligibility criteria must be frozen before payload access.
design.smallest_falsifier: Freeze one aggregate directional statistic D = conditional information(run-length;right-neighbour) minus conditional information(run-length;left-neighbour), weighted by physical leaf rather than prolific token. Compute conditional repeat-label permutations within the fixed matched strata to calibrate sparse-category bias. Preserve the paired left/right contexts and number of doubles. This is an association reference, not a generated historical manuscript or whole-search significance test. D>0 alone is insufficient: report separate left/right effect sizes and their conditional references so a large bilateral shift is not called a right-only reset.
design.capacity_stop: Before any fit, report eligible same-word/same-leaf matched strata and physical-leaf counts, separately by reader. If no within-stratum label movement or no more than one contributing physical leaf remains, stop as insufficient capacity. Do not loosen strata, pool readers, add approximate spellings or shift windows to obtain a result. Final numeric evidence thresholds and permutation count require root selection and preregistration; this RAW is not score-ready.
design.changed_observable: The internal transition X→X is guaranteed by selection and cannot be evidence. The new measured consequence concerns the two EXTERNAL neighbours relative to singleton uses of the same word on the same leaf. It can be absent despite many doubles, or symmetric rather than right-directed.

research_decisions.right_specific: Reject only the frozen context-neutral duplication null; prioritize a concrete existing repeated construction for contextual authorship, while retaining context-dependent copying and nonsemantic layout alternatives. No automatic sentence boundary or translation.
research_decisions.symmetric: Do not adopt a directional reset; broader contextual selection remains possible.
research_decisions.no_supported_difference: No support for this reset mechanism; do not infer that all doubles are errors or semantically empty.
research_decisions.insufficient_capacity: Do not implement a broader model or expand access solely for this statistic.

predecessors.difference: 43 adjacent inherited action-atom pairs receive reversible twice wording; no raw whole-word singleton-vs-double external-neighbour test or semantic validation.

design.positive_baseline: Directed local composition and entry-context effects motivate controlling whole form, physical position and leaf. They do not already imply that duplication resets discourse. Whole-form identity is used directly; no inherited atom meanings or alphabet needed.
design.historical_limit: Ordinary copying duplication, rhetorical repetition and end-to-start reprise remain distinct mechanisms. The existing820/821 source discussion demonstrates alternatives but supplies no calibrated historical error model.
design.budget_if_selected: Small single-pass count/conditional-reference design only; inclusive30min budget for preparing registration, implementation, validation and deciding whether there is information. No neural model, decoder, new corpus or automatic followup. Parent may decline because the result remains structural rather than a word meaning.
design.access: Route/topic, bounded idea/route searches and existing primary reports only. No target payload, image, reserve, global route/ledger edit or test execution.
